name: OneRoster 1.2
description: OneRoster 1.2 rostering endpoints for SIS troubleshooting (PowerSchool SIS, Infinite Campus, ...). Set oneroster_base_url and credentials in an environment. Default auth is OAuth 2.0 client credentials; an environment can override it (e.g. Infinite Campus OneRoster 1.1 uses OAuth 1.0 HMAC-SHA256). Tip: turn on 'Fetch all pages' on a list request to pull every record.
